signal: Selerix acquired TBX in Feb 2025 and Steele Benefits in Sept 2025, building an all-in-one benefits administration platform serving 14M+ employees

email.body1:
Stacy, saw Selerix acquired TBX and Steele Benefits to build an all-in-one benefits platform.

Two acquisitions in a year usually means more cross-sell accounts in play than the sales team can cover, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Selerix off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Stacy, quick follow-up for Selerix.

After folding in two platforms, the cross-sell expectation on sales usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need booked to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Selerix needs to hit target across the combined base, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Stacy, last bit of proof for Selerix.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Selerix's reply rate likely compares to peers integrating acquisitions. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Stacy, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating two acquisitions into one motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Selerix either way.
